item.title: AI handles incidents, engineers lose touch with their systems
item.description:
📝 And when an ambiguous, high-severity incident comes in that automation cannot solve, responding engineers will be in trouble. When AI runs into a hard, never-seen-before incident it cannot solve, engineers will have to take over with less practice than they would have had before. She explained that automation reduces operators’ opportunities to practice routine work while leaving them responsible for new and abnormal situations.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sylvainkalache.com/blog/ai-handles-incidents-engineers-lose-touch-with-their-systems
